title: CodeChallenge: GED for category isolation across layers (part 2)

cues.en: Welcome back to this code challenge.
cues.zh: 歡迎回到這次程式挑戰。

cues.en: I hope you are feeling refreshed and ready to continue.

cues.en: The goal here is to run some analyses over all of the layers in the model, using the two functions that you wrote in the previous two exercises.
cues.zh: 目標是使用前兩個練習寫的兩個函數，對模型所有層執行一些分析。

cues.en: And also I have some additional code in here to test for generalization performance.

cues.en: So here you can see I am looping over all of the layers in the model.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，我遍歷模型中的所有層。

cues.en: So all the transformer blocks.
cues.zh: 也就是所有 Transformer 區塊。

cues.en: I'm also using this Tqdm library to get a progress bar to print out while it's running.
cues.zh: 我也使用 tqdm 函式庫，在執行時印出進度條。

cues.en: Okay, so the first step is to compress the training data using the PCA function from exercise three.

cues.en: So so far this is not that interesting.
cues.zh: 到目前為止，還沒有那麼有趣。

cues.en: Just make sure you are assigning meaningful variable names to the outputs of these two functions.
cues.zh: 只要確認，有為這兩個函數的輸出，指派有意義的變數名稱。

cues.en: The next thing to do inside this loop is to run some t tests.
cues.zh: 迴圈中接下來要做的，是執行一些 t 檢定。

cues.en: So you want to calculate some t tests on for the him versus the her activations in the GED based on
cues.zh: 要在基於 him 大於 her 的 GED 中，對 him 與 her 活化

cues.en: him greater than her and also for the GED from her greater than him.
cues.zh: 做 t 檢定；也對 her 大於 him 的 GED 做相同檢定。

cues.en: This is running a statistical test on exactly the data that we have used to create the eigenvectors.
cues.zh: 這是在用來建立特徵向量的完全相同資料上，執行統計檢定。

cues.en: That means that there is a risk of overfitting here.
cues.zh: 這代表，有過度擬合的風險。

cues.en: Now, on the one hand, it is not trivial that the t tests will all be statistically significant, but
cues.zh: 一方面，並不是所有 t 檢定都理所當然會達統計顯著，

cues.en: it certainly is true that these tests here will be biased towards a larger magnitude T value, because
cues.zh: 但這些檢定確實會偏向較大的 t 值量值，因為

cues.en: they are the data that we used to define the eigenvectors.
cues.zh: 它們就是用來定義特徵向量的資料。

cues.en: Also keep in mind that because of the sign indeterminacy of the eigenvectors, we don't really care about the sign of the t values here.
cues.zh: 也記得，特徵向量的正負號具有不確定性，所以我們不太在意這裡 t 值的正負號。

cues.en: We just want to know their magnitude and their p value.
cues.zh: 只想知道量值和 p 值。

cues.en: And that's why I just store the magnitude or the absolute value of the t value here.
cues.zh: 所以，我在這裡只儲存 t 值的量值，也就是絕對值。

cues.en: You can also see that I'm organizing all of the results in this for loop into a big matrix that I call GED results.
cues.zh: 也可以看到，我把這個 for 迴圈的所有結果，整理成一個稱為 GED results 的大矩陣。

cues.en: So it's going to be 12 for GPT two small.

cues.en: The second dimension is for the particular analysis that I'm storing these results from.

cues.en: Okay.

cues.zh: 分析，也很難從概念、程式碼，以及結果解讀上理解。

cues.en: And yeah, I think it's also very nice to see when analyses have replications built into them.
cues.zh: 而且，看到分析本身內建了重現，也非常好。

cues.en: So that is to say, we did not explicitly have the goal of replicating the effective dimensionality results.
cues.zh: 也就是說，我們並沒有明確設定重現有效維度結果的目標。

cues.en: And in fact, when I made those lectures back there, I was not thinking that I would have separate lectures that would accidentally reproduce those findings.
cues.zh: 事實上，製作前面那些課程時，我沒想到後面會有其他課程，意外重現那些發現。

cues.en: It just kind of happened because when you start to work with a lot of analyses, you start to appreciate the convergence of foundational analysis techniques.
cues.zh: 只是自然發生，因為當你開始做大量分析，就會逐漸體會到基礎分析技術的匯聚。

cues.en: These are methods that just keep appearing in lots of analysis applications.
cues.zh: 這些方法，不斷出現在各種分析應用中。

cues.en: And Eigendecomposition is certainly one of those foundational methods that keeps popping up.
cues.zh: 而特徵分解，絕對就是其中一種反覆出現的基礎方法，

cues.en: The more time you spend doing data science.
cues.zh: 隨著你花更多時間做資料科學，就會不斷遇見。
